themes_detail.label: Elevator Failures Spike
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints in CD 404 jumped to 26 THIS WEEK, a 225% spike above the 8-week average of 8 complaints per week (z-score: 7.86), signaling potential failures in residential and commercial buildings that leave residents—especially elderly and disabled—stranded.
evidence: 26 elevator complaints THIS WEEK vs. 8.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 7.86 indicates statistically severe anomaly
Spike concentrated in single reporting period, not gradual trend
reporting_angles: Which buildings have repeat elevator failures? Are landlords ignoring maintenance orders?
Impact on seniors and disabled residents relying on functioning elevators

themes_detail.label: Mobile Food Vendor Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Mobile food vendor complaints spiked to 5 THIS WEEK, a 700% jump above the 8-week baseline of 0.6 complaints per week (z-score: 9.04), suggesting either new illegal vendors moving in or coordinated enforcement sweeps triggering reports.
evidence: 5 mobile food vendor complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 9.04 indicates statistically severe spike
Sudden concentration suggests new activity or enforcement action
reporting_angles: Is DSNY or health department running a food vendor enforcement blitz?
Are unlicensed vendors proliferating in specific neighborhoods (parks, transit hubs)?

themes_detail.label: Park Noise Complaints Explode
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from parks in CD 404 jumped to 6 THIS WEEK, a 586% spike above the 8-week average of 0.9 per week (z-score: 5.53), indicating potential new gatherings, events, or equipment use disrupting residents.
evidence: 6 park noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Aligns with warming weather potentially driving more outdoor activity
reporting_angles: Are new events, parties, or gatherings happening in specific parks?
Is Parks Department aware of noise issues and can they respond?

themes_detail.label: Commercial Noise Complaints Rise
themes_detail.summary: Commercial noise complaints spiked to 22 LAST WEEK, a 252% increase above the 8-week average of 6.2 per week (z-score: 5.06), suggesting new bar/restaurant activity, construction, or delivery operations.
evidence: 22 commercial noise complaints LAST WEEK vs. 6.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Sustained elevation suggests ongoing source rather than one-off event
reporting_angles: Which businesses are generating complaints? Are they new or recently expanded?
Are NYPD noise enforcement units responding to calls?

themes_detail.label: Animal Abuse Reports Double
themes_detail.summary: Animal abuse complaints surged to 8 TWO WEEKS AGO, a 482% spike above the 8-week average of 1.4 per week (z-score: 4.7), raising concerns about potential illegal dogfighting, hoarding, or neglect in the neighborhood.
evidence: 8 animal abuse complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Requires investigation into whether reports point to specific location or pattern
reporting_angles: Did ASPCA or NYPD investigate the reports? What were the findings?
Is there evidence of organized dogfighting or animal hoarding operations?
